title: Grateful Dead Live at Pelletier Farm on 1969-08-23
lineage: SBD > MC (Bear's) > Dick's Cass > DAT > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture with prominent organ, showcasing a blazing Dark Star and Turn On Your Love Light from an energetic 1969 performance.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its powerful Dark Star, extended Turn On Your Love Light, and fiery Hard to Handle, with Tom Constanten’s organ soaring throughout.  The recording is a soundboard source that, despite hiss, low volume and a brief mono switch, offers a clear enough picture of the band’s 1969 energy, especially highlighting the organ mix.  Overall listeners find the performance compelling and worth the occasional audio quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, highlighting standout jams; recording issues are noted but not enough to outweigh the strong musical performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hiss and low volume reported; organ (TC) unusually high in mix; a mono switch occurs around 24:30 into Turn On Your Love Light; overall decent clarity for a 1969 board tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, exploratory jams with a strong second‑half focus on extended improvisations; organ presence ties the set together despite occasional tape flip loss of verses.

band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s organ is prominently mixed, described as ‘rocking out’, psychedelic and essential to the Dark Star and overall texture.
